properties.description:
Planned 2026-10-07, build order 2 of 7, batched with the root-cause skill change: one step in capture-intent, brainstorm and link-ideas. Before or after writing, search for an umbrella requirement or idea the new piece is a facet of, and link it (DECOMPOSES for a requirement, EVOLVES_INTO or ANTICIPATES for an idea) or say none fits.



AS BUILT 2026-10-07: capture-intent (after the EVOLVES_INTO step: DECOMPOSES to the whole, or say none fits), brainstorm (step 4, item 5: ANTICIPATES or EVOLVES_INTO to the whole, or note none) and link-ideas (step 3) each ask whether the new piece belongs under a whole already recorded.
properties.name: Writing a new idea or requirement asks whether it belongs under a whole already recorded, and links it there (F4)
